In eight grade I was “the new girl from Canada” (my family had just moved to New Jersey) on top of having undiagnosed social anxiety.
In high school (c. 2006) I turned to Google to figure out was was “wrong” with me and found articles on social anxiety and felt so seen and validated for the first time.

The sense of complete validation I felt in that moment (and a whole lot of “told you so!!!!” for the then-bff who ~shockingly~ turned out to be toxic and I now haven’t spoken to in 7 years) is indescribable.
